item: Second WWOX-null clone or WWOX re-expression arm of the HAP1 genetic-interaction screen (N-P1B-1)
decisive_datum: reproduction of the PDHA1, CS, LIPT1 and NDUFAF1 (positive) and SLC2A1 and HK2 (negative) calls in a second clone or a rescue arm
queries_and_sources: source: GSE298081 and its authors' Data S4 (read in IT12 P1-alt); one clone, no replicate or rescue arm
trigger_to_reopen: the data holders report a second clone or a re-expression screen, or a new deposit appears
owner_or_route: operator (a request to the data holders through the contacts in the public record; no personal address is sent by the module)

item: Genetic-interaction readout in WWOX-null versus corrected human neural cells (N-P1B-2)
decisive_datum: a CRISPR screen or a targeted knockdown panel (LDHA, PDHA1, SLC2A1, HK2, HIF1A) with a proliferation, viability or activity endpoint in iPSC-neuron, neural progenitor or organoid; merged with the isogenic experiments already specified for K01, E02 and E03
trigger_to_reopen: a neural isogenic line becomes available or a deposit of such a screen appears
owner_or_route: operator or the owner of the isogenic lines

item: DepMap bulk test of WWOX expression or copy number against PDHA1, CS, SLC2A1 and HK2 dependency (N-P1B-3)
verdict: NEEDS-DATUM (hypothesis only; dependency is not rescue)

queries_and_sources: source: the portal needs a human-verification step and cannot be used by the module; the release licence is to be read first
trigger_to_reopen: an operator-run bulk download of the release is made and its licence read
